summary.headline: Astrological and Warlike Texts
summary.text: Description of a Vatican codex with treatises on the spider, astrolabe, chronological and astronomical tables, planetary courses and latitudinal approaches; followed by a fragment attributed to Theophilus on beginnings of war, including chapters on warlike beginnings, centers, configurations, applications, separations, and trigons.
